voiceNote: Kokoro af_bella (Coach Bella), generated by the lead

chapters.label: Live: bronze in Bangkok
chapters.text: Bangkok, 2012, the Futsal World Cup. Italy’s captain is number three, Marcio Forte, born in Brazil. The whistle goes! Italy beat Colombia three nil and win the bronze medal.

chapters.label: How he plays
chapters.text: This is how he plays. Forte is the fixo, the last defender. He looks up and finds the pivot, far away. One long pass skips the whole defence!

chapters.label: Replay: over the defence
chapters.text: Slowly now. Over three defenders, to the pivot’s feet. He controls it, turns and scores!

chapters.label: Practise it
chapters.text: Try it! Look up first. A long, accurate pass to the pivot can skip the whole defence.
